status.label: Status
status.intro: Travel plugins must be ready. For combat, only what you picked under General → Combat rotation needs to be ready. Auto-shop needs the backend picked under Shopping (GatherBuddy Reborn or Knightshopper).
status.shopping_intro: Auto-shop Returns to base camp if needed, then runs the selected backend when your silver/gold threshold is hit. GatherBuddy Reborn: configure the list in its Vendors window. Knightshopper: configure the list in Knightshopper.
status.optional_intro_bmr: Wrath Combo also needs BossMod or BossMod Reborn.
status.optional_intro_rsr: Wrath Combo and Rotation Solver Reborn also need BossMod.
status.optional_intro_rsr_bmr: Wrath Combo and Rotation Solver Reborn also need BossMod or BossMod Reborn.
status.map_loading: Map still loading — wait until Status shows Ready
status.install_tooltip: Install {plugin} from its plugin repository (the repository is added if missing).
status.repo_failed: Could not add the {plugin} repository. See /xllog for details.
status.install_failed: Could not install {plugin}. Check the plugin installer or /xllog for details.
status.leftover_removed: Removed leftover {plugin} files and installed the plugin.
status.leftover_in_use: Could not install {plugin}: leftover files at '{path}' are in use. Close the game or delete that folder, then try again.
